subject: Quick favor — one-line verdict after our discovery call
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@atlas-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + quick next step question

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so the team is aligned: 

- Primary goal: replace a brittle inference stack and get predictable per-request latency for inference at 100–300 RPS during peak with 200ms P95 target.
- Data residency: need EU data-at-rest for some models; initial pilot can run in our US cloud region but must support private VPC for production.
- Success criteria: (1) hit the latency SLO under the customer workload, (2) reduce token cost by ~30% vs current baseline, (3) audit logs + RBAC for compliance.

What I can do next: Marissa (cc’d) can run a short performance deep-dive — 30 minutes where we validate expected P95 with a synthetic snippet of your workload and show how autoscaling/batching behaves.

Two quick questions to pick a follow-up:
1) Is next Wednesday (Nov 8) afternoon PST workable for a 30-minute session?
2) If not, would you prefer we share a short one-page baseline that shows expected latency/cost for your sample?

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a one-slide architecture sketch for reference.

Appreciate any preference — even a one-line reply is fine.

—
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: discovery_notes-AtlasSystems.pdf

Hi Aisha —

Following up briefly since I know priorities shift quickly. Two quick asks (pick one):

1) If you have 30 seconds: could you reply with a one-line verdict on why this isn’t a fit now? (e.g., "budget", "timing", "different priority"). That will help us avoid noise and time our outreach better.

2) If you’re open, Marissa can run a 20-minute show-and-tell with a tiny synthetic workload so you can see whether the latency story actually meets your bar — no contract, no access to your infra required. We can do that on your timeline.

I re-attached the short one-pager and the architecture image in case they got buried. If it helps, here’s the HubSpot link for this contact: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/HS-8273

Either way — a one-line note is perfect. If now is still not the right time, we’ll set a soft touch for late Q4 and check back in early Jan.

Thanks —
